Name: Bobo's - 10 Oat Recipes for Cornucopia - More Crops
Author: Spectrumnist
Description:
[center][b][size=5]✦  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]  ✦  [url=https://eatbobos.com]Bobo's Website[/url] ✦[/size][/b][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8]This simple mod adds 10 new oat-based cooking recipes using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] mod. These recipes are inspired by the real world oat bite snacks from a company called Bobo's. Each recipe gives different buffs with varying strengths, and sell prices are adjusted accordingly!
Recipes are unlocked automatically, no need to purchase from Gus or receive a letter in the mail.[/color]
